## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, General Driving

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
Right turns launch from the right-most lane edge, while left turns launch from the left-most edge after yielding to oncoming traffic [A01].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A02
Driveway turnabouts center the car in the drive, while two-lane turnabouts hold right of the center line or your own side [A02].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A02
Fresh greens demand a patience check for crossing traffic, while reds and stops facing others still demand a both-way look [A02].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F07, sec07-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A03
Bus stops bind traffic in both directions, while the lone exception frees only opposite-side drivers on a divided four-or-more-lane road [A03].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A04
Perpendicular exits back straight until the front bumper clears, while parallel entries reverse until the front bumper aligns [A04].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F14, sec07-F15 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A05
Hill parking aims wheels at the curb or off the road, while every stop ends with engine off, key out, and doors locked [A05].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F18 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: FX-sec07-R07-P
With at least three lanes in one direction, use the middle for through travel, the left for passing or a left turn, and the right for slower travel, entry or a right turn. With two lanes in one direction, reserve the left for passing [FX-sec07-R07-P].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F20 [FX-sec07-R07-P].
Source: [FX-sec07-R07-P -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A05
Missed turns loop around at the next intersection, while committed turns follow through without last-second swerves [A05].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F21 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A06
Highway entries speed up in the acceleration lane and yield to existing flow, while exits hold speed and then slow in the deceleration lane [A06].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F24, sec07-F25 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A06
A solid line on your side bans the pass, while a solid yellow left of the broken yellow permits it [A06].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F27 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A07
Car passes return once the passed car fills the outside mirror, while bike passes keep 3 feet of left-side room throughout [A07].
Why it matters: group general-driving; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F28, sec07-F30 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0056]
